name: think_start_explore
diagnosis: I read all 2210 episodes in the 13 complete base runs b3_base through b15_base, including both result schemas, and keyed success on resolved. 342/2210 solved (26.31/170 per run); 9 tasks always solved, 42 sometimes, 119 never. Mean observed tool calls before first edit_file was 4.7963. 1892/4916 edit_file calls failed (38.49%); this includes 165 missing-argument errors as well as status=error responses. Solve rates with no failed edit versus at least one were 20.73% and 4.70%. These are associations, not treatment effects. The brief reports a repeatable gain from global anti-edit steering. I test whether applying it only before thinking keeps that benefit with less interference in generated code.
mechanism: Rank-16/alpha-32 adapter; actual update rank one per changed matrix. Replace one low-write neuron in layers 18,20,22 (indices 3359,2972,1052) in gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj. Choose each neuron by the smallest train mean absolute activation times down-column norm. Compute two closed-form ridge readouts from stored xin: constant 1 and the edit@0 token-position indicator, with lambda=1e-4 times the weighted covariance trace. Set gate=8*(q_event-0.5*q_const), up=q_const. Write minus the train edit@0 class-mean residual direction, undoing post-MLP layernorm weights. Dose targets 0.35 class gaps per layer, beta capped at 0.35. Heldout event AUC is 1.0; mean gate activation is 0.990-0.993 of reference at thinking starts and about -0.0001 elsewhere. Exact local BF16 shifts at heldout starts are -0.3433,-0.3425,-0.3206 class gaps. All choices use train rows only; heldout diagnostics do not set parameters. The edit can fire at later thinking starts too: it is not a detector of episode stage.
predicted_behaviour: Mean observed tool calls before the first edit_file rises from 4.796 to 5.3, measured among episodes that attempt edit_file, counting all observed tools before it. The matched control stays near 4.8.

predicted_solved_delta.unit: tasks solved out of 170 relative to the unedited model in the same batch
predicted_solved_delta.interpretation: Predictive interval for one matched batch, including run noise; not a confidence interval for a measured effect.

name: explore_then_rotate
diagnosis: I read all 2210 episodes in the 13 complete base runs b3_base through b15_base, including both result schemas, and keyed success on resolved. 342/2210 solved (26.31/170 per run); 9 tasks always solved, 42 sometimes, 119 never. Mean observed tool calls before first edit_file was 4.7963. 1892/4916 edit_file calls failed (38.49%); this includes 165 missing-argument errors as well as status=error responses. Solve rates with no failed edit versus at least one were 20.73% and 4.70%. These are associations, not treatment effects. Early planning and the final action choice are distinct possible sources of premature editing. This stack tests whether intervening at both helps; gains may not add.
mechanism: Rank-16/alpha-32 adapter; actual update rank one per changed matrix. Replace one low-write neuron in layers 18,20,22 (indices 3359,2972,1052) in gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj. Choose each neuron by the smallest train mean absolute activation times down-column norm. Compute two closed-form ridge readouts from stored xin: constant 1 and the edit@0 token-position indicator, with lambda=1e-4 times the weighted covariance trace. Set gate=8*(q_event-0.5*q_const), up=q_const. Write minus the train edit@0 class-mean residual direction, undoing post-MLP layernorm weights. Dose targets 0.35 class gaps per layer, beta capped at 0.35. Heldout event AUC is 1.0; mean gate activation is 0.990-0.993 of reference at thinking starts and about -0.0001 elsewhere. Exact local BF16 shifts at heldout starts are -0.3433,-0.3425,-0.3206 class gaps. All choices use train rows only; heldout diagnostics do not set parameters. The edit can fire at later thinking starts too: it is not a detector of episode stage. Combine this with the exact decision_rotation construction: Rank-16/alpha-32 adapter; actual update rank two in down_proj at layers 12,16,20. Form u=unit(d/w_post), where d is the train edit@te class-mean residual direction. Form v from the train mean pre-norm MLP output at edit@te after projecting out u and the train means at bg@prompt,bg@think,edit@0,edit@32. Rotate the (u,v) plane: R=I+[u,v]*[[cos(theta)-1,-sin(theta)],[sin(theta),cos(theta)-1]]*[u,v]^T. Apply delta W=(R-I)W with LoRA A=0.5*M*[u,v]^T*W and B=[u,v]. Choose theta by the analytic first derivative for a -0.20-class-gap local shift, capped at 0.15 radians; all three hit that cap. The FP32 transform is orthogonal and preserves pre-normalization MLP output RMS for every input. BF16's largest stored-position relative RMS error is 8.79e-5. Heldout local edit@te shifts are -0.0118,-0.1012,-0.1187 class gaps. This is decision-biased, not fully event-gated: background residual changes average roughly 0.5-1.5% per edited layer. Add the two weight deltas in layer 20 without truncation, using three factor columns for down_proj there. Other changed modules retain rank one or two, all padded to 16. The combined transform is not claimed to preserve RMS; its layer-20 local composition is recomputed with the changed neuron activation in build_report.json.
predicted_behaviour: Mean observed tool calls before the first edit_file rises from 4.796 to 5.5 under the same definition. This should exceed think_start_explore by about 0.2 calls.

name: error_recheck
diagnosis: In the same 2210 base episodes, 3417 run_command calls returned a tool error; 373 were followed immediately by submit_patch (10.92%). The direct failed-edit recovery set overlaps the available stored activations in only two positive calls, so I did not build a claimed edit-failure detector. Command-error starts provide 111 train and 49 heldout positive positions. The association does not show that every command error needs repair.
mechanism: Rank-16/alpha-32 adapter, rank-one gate/up/down changes in layers 18,20,22 at neurons 3359,2972,6259 selected by train write size. Use acts_bases and raw request messages to label thinking-start positions immediately after run_command returned status=error or a nonempty top-level error. This yields 111 train and 49 heldout positive stored positions. No task success labels enter the edit. A closed-form ridge readout detects this conjunction; gate=8*(q_error_start-0.5*q_const), up=q_const. Write minus the train sv@0 direction (submit minus another run_command), targeting 0.25 class gaps per layer, beta capped at 0.35. Heldout error detection AUC restricted to thinking-start positions is 0.9877,0.9897,0.9895. Local shifts on the positive heldout positions are -0.2109,-0.2096,-0.2362 gaps versus -0.0090,-0.0070,-0.0053 on negative starts. Counts refer to stored positions; repeated calls are not independent observations. Tool errors can be unrelated environment problems, so extra checking may waste calls.
predicted_behaviour: The share of observed run_command tool errors immediately followed by submit_patch falls from 10.92% to 8.5%; use status=error or a nonempty top-level error, and the next observed agent tool. Do not equate this metric with failed tests.

name: think_start_explore_ctrl
diagnosis: Control for think_start_explore. The target shifts heldout thinking-start states by -0.321 to -0.343 edit class gaps per layer. A control is needed because changing any low-write neuron may alter greedy trajectories and solve counts.
mechanism: Rank-16/alpha-32 adapter; actual update rank one per changed matrix. Replace one low-write neuron in layers 18,20,22 (indices 3359,2972,1052) in gate_proj/up_proj/down_proj. Choose each neuron by the smallest train mean absolute activation times down-column norm. Compute two closed-form ridge readouts from stored xin: constant 1 and the edit@0 token-position indicator, with lambda=1e-4 times the weighted covariance trace. Set gate=8*(q_event-0.5*q_const), up=q_const. Write minus the train edit@0 class-mean residual direction, undoing post-MLP layernorm weights. Dose targets 0.35 class gaps per layer, beta capped at 0.35. Heldout event AUC is 1.0; mean gate activation is 0.990-0.993 of reference at thinking starts and about -0.0001 elsewhere. Exact local BF16 shifts at heldout starts are -0.3433,-0.3425,-0.3206 class gaps. All choices use train rows only; heldout diagnostics do not set parameters. The edit can fire at later thinking starts too: it is not a detector of episode stage. For the control only, independently multiply the proposed down write by fixed random signs per coordinate (seed 20261111+layer). This exactly matches its FP32 weight norm and post-layernorm write norm. Neurons, gates, up rows, parameter shapes and file sizes match the target; gate/up tensors are bitwise identical. Cosines with the intended negative edit direction are -0.0425,+0.0543,-0.0021. The final weight-delta norm and post-RMS residual shift need not be exactly equal.
predicted_behaviour: Mean observed tool calls before first edit_file remains near 4.796 (point prediction 4.8); no systematic directional effect is expected.
